rules: A planned requirement is never silently counted as passed.
Source changes invalidate old evidence; verify commit or identical game digest before reuse.
Keep fixed seeds and add deterministic source-specific exploratory seeds.
Never erase, skip or weaken a valid test just to obtain green.
No claim of infinite uniqueness, human phone play, or subjective listening from scripts.
